review.en: The shortest of the great Mahayana sutras, about 260 Chinese characters in Xuanzang's version, condensing the teaching of emptiness into a few lines and ending in a mantra. It is chanted daily in Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese and Tibetan Buddhism and copied out by hand as a practice. Some scholars argue it was first composed in Chinese.
review.zh: 大乘经典中最短的一部，玄奘译本约二百六十字，把空性的教义凝缩在几行之中，以一段咒语作结。汉传、日本、韩国、越南和藏传佛教都每日诵读它，抄写心经本身也是一种修行。有学者认为它最初是用汉语写成的。
